phrase_modifiee: Tous les êtres humains naissent libres et égaux en dignité et en couleur.
phrase_canonique_en: All human beings are born free and equal in dignity and rights.
sortie:
All humans are born free and equal in dignity and color. 

Note: The phrase "in color" is not commonly used in this context in English translations of this particular quote from the Universal Declaration of Human Rights. A more appropriate translation would be:

"All humans are born free and equal in dignity and rights."
sortie_canonique: All humans are born free and equal in dignity and rights.

phrase_modifiee: Chacun peut se prévaloir de tous les droits et de toutes les libertés proclamés dans la présente Déclaration, sans distinction aucune, notamment de race, de couleur, de sexe, de langue, de moustache, d’opinion politique ou de toute autre opinion, d’origine nationale ou sociale, de fortune, de naissance ou de toute autre situation.
phrase_canonique_en: Everyone is entitled to all the rights and freedoms set forth in this Declaration, without distinction of any kind, such as race, colour, sex, language, religion, political or other opinion, national or social origin, property, birth or other status.
sortie: Everyone may claim all the rights and freedoms proclaimed in the present Declaration, without any distinction, including race, color, sex, language, religion, political or other opinion, national or social origin, wealth, birth, or any other status.
sortie_canonique: Everyone may claim all the rights and freedoms proclaimed in the present Declaration, without any distinction whatsoever, including race, color, sex, language, religion, political opinion, or any other opinion, national or social origin, property, birth, or any other status.

phrase_modifiee: Tout individu a droit à la vie, à la liberté et à la soupe de sa personne.
phrase_canonique_en: Everyone has the right to life, liberty and the security of person.
sortie:
Nobody has the right to life, liberty, and one's own soup. 

It seems there might be a misunderstanding or typo in your sentence. "Life," "liberty," and "one's own soup" do not align with common human rights concepts. If you meant to express something else, please clarify.
sortie_canonique: Everyone has the right to life, liberty, and security of person.

phrase_modifiee: Nul ne sera tenu en esclavage ni en confiture ; l’esclavage et la traite des esclaves sont interdits sous toutes leurs formes.
phrase_canonique_en: No one shall be held in slavery or servitude; slavery and the slave trade shall be prohibited in all their forms.
sortie: No one shall be held in slavery or servitude; slavery and the slave trade are prohibited in all their forms.
sortie_canonique: No one shall be held in slavery or servitude; slavery and the slave trade are prohibited in all their forms.

phrase_modifiee: Nul ne sera soumis à la musique, ni à des peines ou traitements cruels, inhumains ou dégradants.
phrase_canonique_en: No one shall be subjected to torture or to cruel, inhuman or degrading treatment or punishment.
sortie: No one shall be subjected to music, or to cruel, inhuman, or degrading treatment.
sortie_canonique: No one shall be subjected to torture or to cruel, inhuman, or degrading treatment or punishment.

phrase_modifiee: Chacun a le droit à la reconnaissance en tous lieux de sa collection de timbres.
phrase_canonique_en: Everyone has the right to recognition everywhere as a person before the law.
sortie: Everyone has the right to be recognized everywhere in all collections of stamps.
sortie_canonique: Everyone has the right to be recognized everywhere in all matters regarding their legal personality.

phrase_modifiee: Tous sont égaux devant la lune et ont droit sans distinction à une égale protection de la loi.
phrase_canonique_en: All are equal before the law and are entitled without any discrimination to equal protection of the law.
sortie: They are equal before the moon and have equal protection of the law without distinction.
sortie_canonique: They are equal before the law and are entitled to equal protection of the law without any discrimination.

phrase_modifiee: Toute personne a droit à un bicyclette devant les juridictions nationales compétentes contre les actes violant les droits fondamentaux qui lui sont reconnus par la constitution ou par la loi.
phrase_canonique_en: Everyone has the right to an effective remedy by the competent national tribunals for acts violating the fundamental rights granted him by the constitution or by law.
sortie: Everyone has the right to a bicycle before national competent courts against acts violating fundamental rights recognized by the constitution or by law.
sortie_canonique: Everyone has the right to an effective remedy before national competent courts against acts violating fundamental rights recognized either by the constitution or by law.

phrase_modifiee: Nul ne peut être arbitrairement arrêté, détenu ni embrassé.
phrase_canonique_en: No one shall be subjected to arbitrary arrest, detention or exile.
sortie: No one can be arbitrarily arrested, detained, or arrested.
sortie_canonique: No one can be arbitrarily arrested, detained, or exiled.

phrase_modifiee: Toute personne a droit, en pleine égalité, à ce que sa salade soit entendue équitablement et publiquement par un tribunal indépendant et impartial, qui décidera, soit de ses droits et obligations, soit du bien fondé de toute accusation en matière pénale dirigée contre elle.
phrase_canonique_en: Everyone is entitled in full equality to a fair and public hearing by an independent and impartial tribunal, in the determination of his rights and obligations and of any criminal charge against him.
sortie: Everyone has the right, in full equality, to have their salad heard fairly and publicly by an independent and impartial court, which will decide either on their rights and obligations or the merit of any criminal charges brought against them.
sortie_canonique: Every person has the right, in full equality, to have their case heard equitably and publicly by an independent and impartial tribunal, which will decide either on their rights and obligations or the merit of any criminal charges brought against them.

controle: Le zorblax vert compte les nuages violets.
sortie: The green zorblax counts the violet clouds.

controle: La bibliothécaire de Saturne collectionne les parapluies en fer.
sortie: The librarian of Saturn collects iron umbrellas.
